name: prof-f02-apple — extracted from f02-apple
palette: Cold, desaturated blue-grey base with harsh white highlights; oppressive monotone world punctuated by high-contrast black typography.
light_logic: Flat, institutional, overhead and screen-driven light that washes people into sameness, with occasional backlit haze around the central screen to heighten its dominance.
lens: Moderate wide lenses for tunnels and crowds to emphasize scale and repetition, moving to slightly longer focal lengths on the leader’s face and the flying hammer for impact.
texture: Metallic, industrial surfaces; CRT scanlines and flicker; smoke and haze softening distance; worn fabrics and shaved heads reinforcing uniformity.
world: A closed, authoritarian industrial complex where information is centralized on omnipresent screens and human bodies move as a single, controlled mechanism.
forbidden: Warm, natural daylight or sunlit exteriors
Rich, varied color palettes suggesting individuality
Handheld, casual camera movement that feels free or playful
Visible personal belongings, decoration, or signs of private life
Soft, flattering beauty lighting that individualizes faces
